Review Dreamflow?

Reviewers mostly praise Dreamflow for combining AI prompting, visual editing, and direct code control in one workflow, which they say makes it fast to go from idea to prototype or even a shipped app. Non-technical users describe a low learning curve and strong design output, while Flutter developers highlight useful details like property editing, widget navigation, scoped edits, checkpoints, codebase-aware assistance, and help with complex UI and animations. The main criticism is narrower: one user reports preview failures and frustration around accessing or downloading code.
